title: I Need You (Memories Series)
creator: Matt Bodett
description: An artist uses historical artworks to examine schizophrenic language and explore "madness" as a cultural identity rather than a clinical label.

title: Alice Sheppard
creator: Riva Lehrer
description: The art piece wants to potray a relationship between an artist and the subject, which is created through the natural behavior of the subject. The subject of this portrait, Alice Sheppard, is a dancer and choreographer who incorporates mobility tools into her choreography.
subject: Riva Lehrer; Portraiture; Disability representation; Power dynamics in art; Stigmatized bodies

title: Brain Fog
creator: Kyrianna
description: The artwork explores the reality of chronic condition and invisible disability. The artist applies therapeutic visualization questionnaires to help the subject develop visual metaphors and communicate their struggles.
subject: KYRIANNA; Chronic pain; Invisible disabilities; Portraiture; Therapeutic visualization

title: Community Care Hands
creator: Cattywampus Puppet Council
description: A large interactive pair of hands was created for the 7th Annual Cattywampus Parade & Block Party in Knoxville. The piece focuses on housing justice and envisioned safe, affordable home for all.

title: Sun and Moon
creator: Elizabeth Jameson
description: This piece is a part of series Reimagined Brain, in which the artist reimagined MRI images of her own brain impaired by multiple sclerosis. Her works reflect the beauty and vulnerability of her imperfect body
subject: Elizabeth Jameson; Multiple sclerosis; Invisible disabilities; Brain scans; Art and medicine
